system.description: When you reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points or force it to retreat, you always instantly receive a forageable or harvestable material from it worth (SL x enemy level x 2), regardless of how it died or escaped. You may combine two raw materials harvested from hunted creatures into one item of their summed value during a rest or camp.
